defective_pattern: Allowing stale, legacy validation reports from earlier monolithic drafts to persist in active deliverable directories (e.g., 03_deliverables/validation_report.json).
why_defective: Stale reports from legacy monolithic workflows trigger continuous fail-closed validation gates when transitioning to atomic micro-stages, creating false-positive FAIL loops.
observed_symptoms: Report in 03_deliverables overall_verdict is FAIL persistently
Legacy report overwrites or conflicts with active micro-stage evaluations
corrective_remedy: Archive or isolate legacy validation reports before executing atomic micro-stage pipelines. Ensure validation strictly evaluates the active micro-stage triads.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect presence of monolithic validation_report.json preventing micro-stage validation
